title: DNA extraction from apple
author: Anthony Venon
materials: Macherey-Nagel NucleoSpin Plant II DNA extraction kit

steps.title: Collect and freeze apple samples
steps.instruction: Collect apple buds and leaves into 2 mL tubes containing stainless‑steel balls, flash‑freeze the tubes, and store at –80 °C for long‑term conservation.

steps.title: Prepare Carlson lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Carlson lysis buffer (400 µL per sample) containing 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 9.5, 2 % (w/v) CTAB, 1.4 M NaCl, 1 % (w/v) PEG 8000, and 20 mM EDTA. Make the buffer in 1–2 L batches at least one day in advance.

steps.title: Load samples into TissueLyser adapters
steps.instruction: Place the frozen sample tubes into pre‑cooled metal adapters compatible with the Qiagen TissueLyser II or III.

steps.title: Homogenize sample with cryogenic cooling
steps.instruction: Run the TissueLyser for 30 s at 22 Hz (first homogenization), immediately immerse the tube and adapter in liquid nitrogen to re‑freeze, then run a second 30 s homogenization at 22 Hz. Refresh adapters in liquid nitrogen between runs if processing many samples.

substeps.instruction: Run TissueLyser 30 s at 22 Hz (first homogenization)
Immerse tube and adapter in liquid nitrogen to re‑freeze
Run TissueLyser 30 s at 22 Hz (second homogenization)

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and RNase
steps.instruction: Immediately add 400 µL Carlson lysis buffer to each tube, then add 10 µL RNase A (from the Macherey‑Nagel NucleoSpin Plant II kit). Mix gently by pipetting up/down or brief vortexing, and incubate at 65 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform
steps.instruction: Working under a chemical fume hood, add 400 µL chloroform to each lysed sample, vortex vigorously for 15 s, then centrifuge at 11 000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min to separate phases.

steps.title: Prepare spin‑column reagents
steps.instruction: While the tubes are centrifuging, place each green silica spin column into a collection tube, and in a separate empty collection tube add 450 µL PC buffer (provided in the kit).

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase to PC buffer
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, carefully collect the upper aqueous phase without disturbing the interphase, transfer it into the tube containing 450 µL PC buffer, and mix thoroughly by pipetting up/down several times.

steps.title: Bind DNA to silica column
steps.instruction: Load 700 µL of the mixture onto the green silica spin column in its collection tube, centrifuge at 11 000 × g, room temperature for 1 min, discard the flow‑through, and place the column back into the same collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with PW1 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL PW1 buffer to the column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g, room temperature for 1 min, discard the flow‑through, and return the column to the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with PW2 (first)
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL PW2 buffer to the column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g, room temperature for 1 min, discard the flow‑through, and return the column to the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with PW2 (second)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL PW2 buffer again to the column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g, room temperature for 5 min to remove residual ethanol, discard the collection tube, and transfer the column to a new clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer column to new 1.5 mL tube

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL pre‑warmed PE elution buffer (55 °C) directly to the center of the column membrane, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, then centrifuge at 11 000 × g, room temperature for 1 min to collect the eluate.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL PE buffer pre‑warmed to 55 °C

steps.title: Optional second elution
steps.instruction: Pipette the eluate back onto the column membrane, wait an additional 5 min, and centrifuge again at 11 000 × g, room temperature for 1 min. Discard the column and retain the eluate in the microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Pipette eluate back onto column membrane

steps.title: Quantify extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and assess purity using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer and/or a Qubit fluorometer.
